source_review.scope: All seven TKT rows, conditions, source bounds, uncertainty, exact marker locations, source identities, method definitions, source-body hashes and user-facing claim wording. Parent separately inspected the table and methods.

representation_review.scope: Parameter types, chemical and assay identity, shared data shape, explicit observation reuse, missingness, fitted-parameter contrasts and non-equivalence boundaries.

adversarial_review.scope: New value relative to existing partial annotations and a competent incumbent reading; all three reconsideration rules and unsupported kinetic/geometry inference.
adversarial_review.decision: accept bounded reusable data value; no scientific-discovery, speed or comparative-accuracy claim

adjudications.objection: T382E X5P-response SD was initially transcribed as 11 uM.
adjudications.evidence: Hash-matched Table 2a image; separate source and representation reads both identify 126 +/- 1 uM.
adjudications.decision: Corrected to 1 before publication; numerical audit repeated only on the affected field.

adjudications.objection: Printed K_M and efficiency headers would misclassify the T382E/Q parameters.
adjudications.evidence: Table footnotes f/g define K_0.5, k_cat/K_0.5 and distinct steady-state Hill coefficients.
adjudications.decision: Typed as the source specifies; no pooled affinity or efficiency ranking.

adjudications.objection: T382E efficiency text 34.127 is ambiguous under the printed unit.
adjudications.evidence: Exact image token and separate 4.30/(126e-6) arithmetic witness.
adjudications.decision: Keep raw string, null unambiguous normalized value and explicit unresolved punctuation; do not repair source silently.

adjudications.objection: T382Q blue n.a. cells do not each carry superscript e.
adjudications.evidence: Its e marker is in the orange pKa cell. Footnote e identifies the missing cofactor band; Methods use that same 325 nm band as the stopped-flow reporter.
adjudications.decision: Retain missing reporter as an explicit source-integration inference, with marker location and raw n.a. preserved.

adjudications.objection: Source kmax lower bounds, large SD and different fit models could be turned into unsupported kinetic relations.
adjudications.evidence: Table footnotes c/d; SI printed pages 6-7, equations 6-8; E160A reverse 0.62 +/- 0.99.
adjudications.decision: Keep >600 as lower bounds, retain SD unchanged, distinguish fit phases, and prohibit inference of NMR K2, raw-transient equivalence or a common affinity constant.

adjudications.objection: Reprojecting existing E160Q and WT/E366Q values or NMR arms could double-count evidence.
adjudications.evidence: Exact prior observation IDs and JSON pointers, with ten numeric summaries verified equal to existing records.
adjudications.decision: Keep DOI/locator/variant/endpoint/parameter identity and reuse mappings; all five NMR arms are inherited context.

adjudications.objection: F6P adduct accumulation or formation could be presented as general activity or evidence for the 6HA3 geometry.
adjudications.evidence: F6P stopped-flow at 4 C, qualitative acid-quench context at 20 C and X5P/R5P turnover at 20 C are distinct measurements.
adjudications.decision: Allow only explicit within-assay source-model comparisons and study/variant context; no F6P full-cycle, geometry causation or exact-preparation claim.

adjudications.objection: Adding code or a full-table copy might repeat prior partial curation without meaningful value.
adjudications.evidence: The previous packets contain the E160Q numerical slice and WT/E366Q kcat; the added rows and parameter qualifiers were absent from those projections.
adjudications.decision: Use additive data and exact reuse bindings; no runtime branch, new validator, raw-source redistribution, performance claim or measured curation speedup.

source_access.limit: Retained local bytes only. Historical unmetered browser discovery remains unresolved; this operation creates no fresh allowance.

verification_scope: Manual exact-source review plus deterministic source-pin, reuse-identity and arithmetic checks; existing repository contracts and CI remain required. These checks verify transcription/integrity, not the physical truth of the study.
publication_limits: Publisher source bodies remain locally retained and are not redistributed. Public hashes and locators permit identity checks when matching source bodies are available; the annotation alone does not reproduce image transcription.
